name: PBBANK
recent: Public Bank 在 2026 年 11 月 6 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩，营收环比下降 1.3%，净利环比下降 2.8%。同期，EPF 与 KWAP 多次申报持股变动。此外，Public Bank 已支持 Apple Pay，Public Islamic Bank 推出免年费信用卡。
notable: Public Bank 发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩。
Public Bank 支持 Apple Pay，并提供最高 RM30 现金回扣。
Public Islamic Bank 推出免年费信用卡。
risks: EPF 在 2026 年 10 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
KWAP 在 2026 年 11 月多次申报持股变动。

recent_en: Public Bank released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 6 November 2026, with revenue down 1.3% QoQ and net income down 2.8% QoQ. Meanwhile, EPF and KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings. Public Bank also added Apple Pay support, and Public Islamic Bank launched a no-annual-fee credit card.
notable_en: Public Bank released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
Public Bank now supports Apple Pay with up to RM30 cashback.
Public Islamic Bank launched a no-annual-fee credit card.
risks_en: EPF filed multiple changes in shareholdings during October to November 2026.
KWAP filed multiple changes in shareholdings in November 2026.
A news headline indicated foreign funds dumped Public Bank shares.
earnings_en: Q3 2026 revenue was MYR 3,773,791,000, down 1.3% QoQ and up 1.3% YoY; net income was MYR 1,773,129,000, down 2.8% QoQ and down 3.8% YoY; net margin was 47.0% versus 47.7% in the previous quarter.
